title: Formal-Informal Mathematical Alignment through and beyond Human Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.31011v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formalized mathematics libraries such as Lean's \texttt{mathlib} provide machine-verifiable representations of mathematical knowledge, including definitions, theorems, and their relationships. If effectively connected to informal mathematical resources, formal mathematics could help uncover previously implicit links between mathematical concepts and improve access to existing formalizations. However, connections between informal and formal mathematics libraries are currently sparse and unsystematic. In this paper, we make first strides towards better formal integration. We construct a dataset linking informal statements from the Stacks Project to their formalizations in \texttt{mathlib} by exploiting expert annotations. We evaluate retrieval, LLM-based reranking, and LLM-assisted verification to discover new unannotated informal-to-formal links. translated_title: 通过人工标注及超越人工标注的形式化-非形式化数学对齐
translated_abstract: 诸如 Lean 的 mathlib 这类形式化数学库提供了数学知识的机器可验证表示，包括定义、定理及其相互关系。如果能够与非形式化数学资源有效连接，形式化数学将有助于揭示数学概念之间此前隐含的联系，并改善对现有形式化成果的获取。然而，目前非形式化数学与形式化数学库之间的连接稀疏且缺乏系统性。在本文中，我们朝着更好的形式化整合迈出了第一步。我们通过利用专家标注，构建了一个将 Stacks Project 中的非形式化陈述与其在 mathlib 中的形式化版本相互关联的数据集。我们评估了检索、基于大语言模型（LLM）的重排序以及 LLM 辅助验证等方法，以发现新的、未经标注的非形式化到形式化的连接。为了便于形式化知识的探索与复用，我们将新发现的（连接）集成到了……（摘要此处不完整）
tldr: 本文构建了将 Stacks Project 的非形式化数学陈述与 Lean mathlib 形式化内容相连接的数据集，并利用检索、LLM 重排序和 LLM 辅助验证等方法，在人工标注之外自动发现新的形式化与非形式化数学之间的对应关系。
